title: Nutrition and metabolism
learning_outcomes: Explain nutrients in the context of nutrition and metabolism.
Compare and distinguish energy balance in the context of nutrition and metabolism.
Apply dietary patterns in the context of nutrition and metabolism.
Evaluate and justify decisions about food labels and evidence in the context of nutrition and metabolism.

lessons.title: Nutrients
lessons.outcome: Explain nutrients in the context of nutrition and metabolism.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving nutrients; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Create an annotated explanation with a concrete example and a counterexample. Connect the result to fictional meal audit.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain nutrients from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of nutrients; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Energy balance
lessons.outcome: Compare and distinguish energy balance in the context of nutrition and metabolism.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving energy balance; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Compare two cases or approaches using explicit criteria; identify an important limitation. Connect the result to fictional meal audit.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain energy balance from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of energy balance; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Dietary patterns
lessons.outcome: Apply dietary patterns in the context of nutrition and metabolism.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving dietary patterns; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Work through a new case or simulation; document assumptions and steps. Connect the result to fictional meal audit.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain dietary patterns from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of dietary patterns; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Food labels and evidence
lessons.outcome: Evaluate and justify decisions about food labels and evidence in the context of nutrition and metabolism.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving food labels and evidence; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Analyse an unfamiliar case; defend a choice, identify uncertainty and revise after feedback. Connect the result to fictional meal audit.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain food labels and evidence from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of food labels and evidence; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

criteria.criterion: Accurate explanation of nutrients; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of energy balance; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of dietary patterns; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of food labels and evidence; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

assessment.threshold: All mapped criteria at level 2; no averaging away missing criteria. Level 3 requires independent novel application, delayed reassessment and appropriate review.
assessment.alternate_evidence: Equivalent accessible written, oral, visual, simulated or supervised evidence; no personal disclosure required.

safety.notes: Draft educational framework only. Use fictional cases; no personal diagnosis, prescription, hazardous practice, financial/legal instruction or unqualified certification. Obtain qualified/local review before publication.
